title: Prudent Corporate Advisory — idea pipeline screen (Nov 2026)

body: Promise-tracker pilot on Skipper Ltd. 10 concalls (Jul-2024 to Oct-2026); 68 forward-looking promises extracted, 48 past-deadline or already re-dated promises scored. Status counts: {'delivered': 16, 'partly': 11, 'pending': 19, 'moved-goalpost': 9, 'missed': 10, 'silently-dropped': 1, 'withdrawn': 1, 'unverifiable': 1}. Weighted delivery ratio (specificity x materiality x recency) = 41.3%; specificity-only = 41.2%; raw hit rate 33.3%; MCS on the -1.5..+1 schema scale = -0.178. Strong on group-level P&L promises: FY25 +41% vs 25% guided; FY26 margin +50 bp; finance cost to ~4% (3.9%); FY26 +20% vs 20-25% guided in Apr-25. Weak on dates and segment targets: both 75k t blocks late (the second block has had five dates: Mar-26, Q1FY27, Jun-26, end-Q2FY27, end-Q3/early-Q4FY27); 600k t moved FY28 -> FY29 without comment; polymer INR 1,000 cr and double-digit margin re-dated twice; export doubling missed (~INR 730 cr vs 1,500); 'no further equity' reversed (INR 433.5 cr preferential, 2026). Precise promises deliver worst (by_specificity), and promises made in FY26 calls delivered far worse than those made in FY25 calls, as growth slowed. Candour index 12.5% of shortfalls admitted unprompted. Misses are usually explained (monsoon, ROW, freight, CEA bidding), but only when an analyst asks, and missed targets are re-labelled 'aspiration'. Debtors: 55 -> 98 days in FY26 despite a volunteered Apr-25 promise that working capital would 'improve considerably'. The 'timing' explanation covers ~INR 260 cr; Sep-26 is still ~78-83 days. Use: haircut management dates by 1-2 quarters and segment targets by ~50%; trust the margin and finance-cost guidance more. Research, not advice.

data.base_rates_note: Single-company pilot. There is no peer base rate yet, so the score is meaningful only against future Skipper quarters and other companies scored the same way.
data.debtor_check: Trade receivables INR 701 cr (Mar-25) -> 1,485 cr (Mar-26) -> 1,223 cr (Sep-26). Debtor days 55 -> 98 -> ~78-83. In Apr-25 management volunteered that WC would 'improve considerably'. The FY26 spike was explained only when an analyst asked: INR 260 cr received 1-2 April, Q4 domestic mix, GST. Ex-INR 260 cr, days are still ~80. By Oct-26 the target had been reset to NWC '90-100 days stable'.
data.grade: C- (below-average credibility; good on margins and finance cost, poor on dates and segment targets)
data.kill_criteria_link: analysis:SKIPPER:2026-11-19 kill criteria include debtor days >120 and borrowings >INR 1,000 cr. Neither is triggered (Sep-26 ~78-83 days; borrowings 757 cr).
data.mcs_scale_note: -1.5 (all moved/dropped) .. +1 (all delivered); weights = specificity(3/2/1) x materiality(1-3) x recency decay (half-life 8 qtrs)
next_checks: Q3FY27 call (Jan/Feb-2027): 450k t commissioning; H2 revenue run-rate vs 15%; order inflow toward 7,500 cr
Q4FY27 results: FY27 +15% revenue / +30% PAT; receivables vs 55-day FY25 base; polymer ~608 cr; finance cost 3.2-3.5%
Greenfield land announcement for 600k t by FY29
data.tone_vs_delivery: High-confidence language ('absolutely', 'for sure', 'well on track', 'no challenge') accompanies ~41% weighted delivery. The guidance that slipped was framed afterwards as 'aspiration'. Every call closes with near-identical upbeat boilerplate whatever the quarter.
